title: Creamy Jubilant Rigatoni
description: A rich and satisfying pasta dish that combines the flavors of creamy sauce and jubilant ingredients.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the australian olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced jubilant and creamy to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked rigatoni and add it to the skillet with the jubilant and creamy sauce.
Toss the rigatoni to combine and serve hot.
Optional: top with additional grated parmesan cheese and a sprinkle of fresh parsley.
